headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • Chemicals: Caustic volumes grew 7.8 yoy and 11.6% qoq. • CSF/CFY volumes grew 6.9% yoy and 11.5% qoq, beat our estimates.

Negatives: • Standalone EBITDA (-48% qoq) was below estimates on higher losses in paints segment. • Chemicals: EBITDA declined to Rs10/kg ((-)17% yoy, (-)41% qoq). • CSF: Margins were under pressure in Q2FY27 due to higher sulfur and pulp costs, with limited ability to fully pass-through cost increases on muted demand.

(EBITDA: Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortization; CAGR: Compound Annual Growth Rate; CSF: Cellulosic Staple Fiber; CFY: Cellulosic Fashion Yarn) ` ` ` The content of this document has been derived from KIE research report.
